description.value: Delicious Pho is a Vietnamese restaurant on downtown Vancouver's Robson Street, one of two Lower Mainland locations (the other in Coquitlam). The menu centres on signature satay pho with aromatic broth, alongside fresh salad rolls, banh mi, and a deluxe combo pho loaded with mixed proteins. The restaurant emphasises traditional recipes and is wheelchair accessible, making it a practical sit-down stop in a busy urban cycling corridor.
